cited.quote: Planting of 70 lakh seedlings for three years from 2017-2018 to 2019-2020

rationale: Directional promise. C5 is a GO (dated 2018-02-23) sanctioning funds for the Massive Tree Planting Programme to increase green cover in degraded forests, a dedicated tree planting campaign. It refers to an earlier GO for the same programme, but that date is garbled in the extract, so the document date of C5 is used.
